## Summary

**Status:** FOUND

**Search Scope:** Official docs (code.claude.com/docs/en/statusline), 8 community GitHub projects, 3 blog posts, awesome-claude-code curated list
**Matches:** 15+ community tools, full official JSON payload schema, direct subagent API documentation

## What We Already Have (Baseline)

`/daaf/.claude/scripts/context-bar.sh` currently shows: model name, dir basename, git branch (branch-only, no dirty state), a 10-segment context bar built from transcript parsing with 3/8-block fill precision, context %, window size in k-tokens, and the last user message as a second line. It handles OpenRouter context-window size lookup via a cached API call. Context is computed from transcript JSONL (not from the payload's `context_window.used_percentage`), which adds transcript-read overhead on every tick.

## 2. Rendering and Performance Best Practices

- **Payload over transcript parsing** where accuracy allows (see caveat above for DAAF's OpenRouter case).
- **Cache git subprocess calls** with session_id-keyed tmpfiles, ~5s TTL. Do not use `$$` (changes every invocation).
- **Consolidate jq calls:** current script calls `jq` 4-5 times on `$input`; a single `jq ... | @tsv` extraction into shell variables saves 3-4 process forks per tick.
- **`refreshInterval`** for subagent-wave visibility (official docs explicitly call out the coordinator-waiting case).
- **Color thresholds should match DAAF's own gating thresholds** (40/60/75), not the docs' 70/90 example.

**Pitfalls reported by the community:**
- `printf '%b'` more reliable than `echo -e` for ANSI (current script already correct).
- OSC 8 hyperlinks require iTerm2/Kitty/WezTerm; stripped elsewhere.
- Multi-line output with escape sequences is glitch-prone; keep second line lightly colored.
- Hanging scripts block the statusline; always timeout network calls (current OpenRouter fetch correct with `--max-time 3`).
- `disableAllHooks: true` also disables the statusline — non-obvious silent failure source.

## 4. Subagent / Multi-Agent Statusline Display

**`subagentStatusLine` is an official separate setting** (code.claude.com/docs/en/statusline). Claude Code passes it a JSON object with a `tasks` array — each task has: `id`, `name`, `type`, `status`, `description`, `label`, `startTime`, `tokenCount`, `tokenSamples`, `cwd`. The command outputs one JSON line per subagent row to override: `{"id": "<task id>", "content": "<row body>"}`. ANSI colors and OSC 8 links supported.

**`refreshInterval` + `subagentStatusLine` together** is the community-recommended pattern for multi-agent visibility.

There is no active-agent-count field in the main statusline payload — subagent visibility in the main bar requires filesystem/side-channel techniques.

- Highest-value new capability for DAAF: `subagentStatusLine` showing active subagent names and token counts during wave dispatch.
